name: Vegas∧RV20≤expanding Q80 1.3x (70% QQQ + 30% QLD + cash)
name_zh: Vegas∧RV20≤扩窗Q80 1.3x（70% QQQ + 30% QLD，空仓现金）

zh: Vegas 隧道（QQQ 收盘）：Mom189>0 且 Close>SMA150 且 Close≥min(EMA144,EMA169)
RV 门（无前视）：rv20=std(20)×√252；q80=截至昨日的扩窗 80% 分位（min_periods=252）；rv_ok=(rv20≤q80)
risk_on = Vegas ∧ rv_ok；开仓 70% QQQ + 30% QLD（或合成 2×），平仓 100% 现金（IRX→BIL）
执行：收盘确认，次日生效（pos=signal.shift(1)）；QQQ+2× 换手 4bps
en: Vegas tunnel on QQQ close: Mom189>0 AND Close>SMA150 AND Close>=min(EMA144,EMA169)
risk_on = Vegas AND rv_ok; risk-on 70% QQQ + 30% 2x (QLD/synth); risk-off 100% cash (IRX→BIL)
Execution: close confirm → pos=signal.shift(1); 4bps on QQQ+2x L1 turnover

metrics.engine: close-to-close + shift(1) weights; cost_bps on QQQ+2x L1; cash IRX→BIL; QLD real after 2006-06-21 else synthetic 2x

disclaimer: Backtest only. Not investment advice. Not live trading.
